name: iGA Istanbul Airport
direct_access_note: First-hand browser access to www.istairport.com/en: 5 pages captured on desktop and mobile (homepage and departures twice, 10:57-11:06 and 14:51-14:53 UTC), 8 more read with Playwright, 4 interaction scripts (headers and keyboard, homepage flight lookup, departures filters and search, site search, mobile menu, car park tabs, flight-detail alert opt-in); all HTTP 200, no bot challenge. Blocked by the container's network policy (not site defects): webnav.poilabs.com and maps.istairport.com (map iframes), igachatbot.etiya.com (chat widget), api.igairport.aero (airline logos), serve.motaword.com, and analytics or advertising hosts. The map, chatbot and airline logos were therefore not observable; igapass.com checkout and the WhatsApp hand-off were not opened. Scores are expert assessments, not instrumented tests.

steps_to_flight_status_note: From the homepage: focus the 'Search for Flight Number / City' field and type the flight number; the matching row appears inline with status, counters and gate. One more click opens the detail page with the WhatsApp opt-in.
axe_note: Homepage, axe-core WCAG A/AA rule violations (desktop 31 nodes, mobile 17). Departures: 3 rules on desktop and mobile (serious 2, moderate 1). Flight detail: 3 desktop, 4 mobile. iGA Cares: 2 desktop, 3 mobile. meta-viewport (zoom disabled) fails on every page.

lighthouse_lab.note: lab, single container, third-party hosts blocked, indicative only

standouts.name: WhatsApp flight updates without an app or account
standouts.why: Any flight's detail page offers push updates through WhatsApp, the channel many passengers already use, with no install or login.

standouts.name: Live checkpoint waiting times
standouts.why: Terminal entrance, passport control and domestic security waits, with the busiest entrance named, on the homepage and every flight page.

standouts.name: Need-based journey directory
standouts.why: Step-by-step guidance per flight and per transfer type that can be tailored to accessibility, family, age-friendly, sensory and visual-description needs.

standouts.name: Inline homepage flight lookup
standouts.why: Status, counters and gate appear under the homepage field in two interactions.

standouts.name: Dining and shop finders with dietary filters and dated offers
standouts.why: Vegan, gluten-free, diabetic, lactose-free and kids-menu filters, airside or landside zones, and 41 dated offers.

weaknesses: Homepage gives more of the first two screens to selling premium services and award announcements than to passenger tasks
No skip link, no detectable focus indicator, zoom disabled, critical ARIA and label errors; accessibility not linked from the header
Flight board has no 'last updated' time, rotates codeshares in one cell, and the detail page can headline one code and list another
Nine third-party marketing and analytics hosts on every page; lab LCP 16.7 s on throttled mobile; no Content-Security-Policy
Map and chatbot depend on third-party hosts and fail silently when unreachable; localisation slips on English pages
ideas: Pair WhatsApp opt-in with a live journey: each alert carries the next step, the gate's walking time and the current queue at the relevant checkpoint
Show checkpoint queues with a trend and a short forecast, not only the current minutes
Remember a passenger's chosen needs on the device and apply them across the site without login
Keep flight and live-status modules ahead of commercial modules; offer services in context, such as a lounge offer when a flight is delayed
Make accessibility the default: skip link, visible focus, zoom allowed, labelled fields, proper landmarks
Keep the map first-party with a text list fallback
gaps: Map (poilabs), car park map, chatbot (Etiya), airline logos and one third-party script (MotaWord) not observable
WhatsApp hand-off not completed; effect of the need filters on the detail page not verified
Automatic board refresh not tested; delayed and diverted labels not seen
App features, MyIST and the virtual assistant rest on search results; no store rating found

2026 Skytrax ranking unconfirmed: one secondary source reports eighth (https://www.listmag.com/en/travel-and-stay/guide/skytrax-world-best-airports); the site's own award claims were not independently checked
Lighthouse and capture timings are lab values from one container with analytics blocked
